|-- Accept keyboard, text and pointer events: Surface callbacks [src/Surface.zig:2669-4870]
|   |-- keyCallback() [2792]: remap modifiers; optionally record inspector event.
|   |   |-- maybeHandleBinding(): resolve key tables / sequences before terminal encoding.
|   |   |   |-- Matching binding: call -> performBindingAction; consumed events return.
|   |   |   `-- Unhandled event: continue; enabled keyboard-disable mode consumes without writing.
|   |   |-- Update mouse/modifier feedback and pressed_key; encodeKey() using terminal modes.
|   |   |   |-- No encoded bytes: return ignored.
|   |   |   |-- Child already exited: discard bytes; call -> Surface.close.
|   |   |   `-- Otherwise: queueIo(write_small / write_stable / write_alloc).
|   |   |       |-- Read-only surface: discard writes, retaining non-write operations.
|   |   |       `-- Termio.queueMessage() => [async] mailbox + wakeup -> I/O loop.
|   |   `-- For non-modifier input: clear selection / scroll to bottom as configured; queueRender().
|   |       `-- renderer_thread.wakeup.notify() => [async] Renderer loop.
|   |-- preeditCallback() [2669]: lock state; replace IME codepoints; mark preedit dirty; queueRender().
|   |-- textCallback() [3426]: call -> completeClipboardPaste with allow_unsafe=true.
|   |-- mouseButtonCallback() / cursorPosCallback() [3918,4678]
|   |   |-- Update button/modifier/position state; inspect links and selection gestures.
|   |   `-- Depending on event, capture mode and configured button action:
|   |       |-- Application mouse capture: mouseReport() encodes report; queueIo() -> I/O loop.
|   |       |-- Local selection: setSelection(); optionally copySelectionToClipboards(); queueRender().
|   |       |-- Drag outside viewport: queueIo(selection_scroll) => [async] I/O selection timer.
|   |       |-- Link / prompt click: processLinks() / maybePromptClick(); open URL or send cursor movement.
|   |       `-- Paste gesture: call -> startClipboardRequest.
|   `-- scrollCallback() [3584]: accumulate pixel deltas into cell-sized scroll amounts.
|       |-- Alternate screen + alternate-scroll mode: queue cursor-key sequences -> I/O loop.
|       |-- Mouse reporting enabled: mouseReport() -> I/O loop.
|       `-- Otherwise: lock Terminal; scrollViewport(); queueRender().

|-- Execute user commands: Surface.performBindingAction() [src/Surface.zig:4941]
|   `-- Dispatch by action scope and tag; alternatives below are not sequential actions.
|       |-- App-scoped: App.newWindow() / App.performAction() / apprt undo or redo.
|       |-- Text / CSI / ESC / cursor-key action: encode; queueIo() -> I/O loop; optionally scroll down.
|       |-- Search action [5100]: lazily create search state and spawn => [async] Search loop.
|       |   |-- Nonempty query / navigation: enqueue change_needle / select; wake search worker.
|       |   `-- Empty query / end_search: stop and join search; notify runtime when ending UI search.
|       |-- Copy / selection action: extract or adjust selection; write clipboard / queueRender().
|       |-- Paste action: call -> startClipboardRequest.
|       |-- Font-size action: call -> setFontSize.
|       |-- Clear / scroll / prompt navigation: queueIo() -> I/O loop, or adjust viewport under lock.
|       |-- Screen / scrollback / selection export: writeScreenFile(); format text; write/open/paste result.
|       |-- Tab / split / window / inspector UI action: rt_app.performAction(); runtime handles native UI.
|       |-- Read-only / mouse-reporting / key-table action: update local input policy or binding state.
|       `-- close_surface: call -> Surface.close.

|-- Exchange clipboard data: Surface clipboard entry points [src/Surface.zig:6017-6611]
|   |-- startClipboardRequest() [6219]
|   |   |-- Snapshot terminal paste mode; choose text request or Kitty MIME-list event.
|   |   |-- Denied OSC 52 read: return unsupported.
|   |   `-- rt_surface.clipboardRequest() => [runtime completion] completeClipboardRequest().
|   |-- completeClipboardRequest() [6017]: dispatch by pending request.
|   |   |-- Paste: completeClipboardPaste() [6264].
|   |   |   |-- Snapshot paste modes under lock; evaluate paste protection.
|   |   |   |   |-- Unsafe and unconfirmed: return UnsafePaste; runtime may ask and retry.
|   |   |   |   `-- Allowed: scroll to bottom; input.paste.encode() normalizes / frames data.
|   |   |   `-- For each nonempty encoded vector, until exhausted: queueIo(write) -> I/O loop.
|   |   |-- MIME list: completeClipboardPasteEvent(); encode Kitty paste event -> I/O loop.
|   |   |-- OSC 52 read: completeClipboardReadOSC52(); permission check; encode response -> I/O loop.
|   |   |-- OSC 52 write: rt_surface.setClipboard(), allowing runtime confirmation.
|   |   `-- Kitty read/write: enforce permission; optionally queue session grant; transfer data and reply.
|   `-- denyClipboardRequest() [6167]: dispose pending protocol state and send required denial response.

|-- Reconfigure geometry and appearance: Surface sizing/config entry points [src/Surface.zig]
|   |-- sizeCallback() [2600]: unchanged size returns; otherwise call resize().
|   |   `-- resize() [2618]: save screen size; balance padding; compute grid dimensions.
|   |       |-- queueIo(resize) => [async] I/O resize coalescing.
|   |       `-- Enqueue renderer resize; queueRender() => [async] Renderer loop.
|   |-- contentScaleCallback() [3765]: unchanged DPI returns; otherwise call setFontSize().
|   |   `-- Recalculate DPI-dependent padding; call -> Surface.resize.
|   |-- setFontSize() [2536]: acquire shared font grid for new size.
|   |   |-- setCellSize(): queue I/O resize; recompute initial size; report cell size to runtime.
|   |   `-- Enqueue font_grid replacement; update local metrics; queueRender().
|   `-- updateConfig() [1804]: apply conditional state; derive replacement config.
|       |-- Derivation fails: keep old configuration and return.
|       `-- Derivation succeeds: replace config; reset key sequence / key tables and mouse policy.
|           |-- Call -> setFontSize, preserving manually adjusted point size.
|           |-- Enqueue renderer change_config; queueIo(change_config); queueRender().
|           `-- rt_app.performAction(set_title / config_change): synchronize native UI.

|-- React to focus, visibility and display lifecycle: Surface callbacks [src/Surface.zig]
|   |-- focusCallback() [3466]: update App focus; return if unchanged; enqueue renderer focus.
|   |   |-- On focus loss: synthesize releases through -> keyCallback for held keys/modifiers.
|   |   `-- queueRender(); showMouse(); update Terminal focus under lock; queueIo(focused).
|   |-- occlusionCallback() [3437]: ignore duplicates; update visibility and Terminal flag.
|   |   `-- Queue enabled visibility report to I/O; enqueue renderer visibility; queueRender().
|   |-- colorSchemeCallback() [4871]: update conditional theme if changed.
|   |   `-- notifyConfigConditionalState(): request soft config reload; queue terminal color-scheme report.
|   |-- displayRealized() / displayUnrealized() [2584]: update renderer display availability.
|   |   `-- Unrealized: wake Renderer loop so GPU resources are released on its thread.
|   |-- refreshCallback() [3554]: queueRender() => [async] Renderer loop.
|   |-- draw() [925]: synchronously call -> Renderer.drawFrame(true), for runtime-driven drawing.
|   `-- reportPresentationHealth() [961]: enqueue presentation_health; wake Renderer loop.

|-- Run queued terminal I/O: termio.Thread.threadMain_() [src/termio/Thread.zig:236]
|   |-- Termio.threadEnter() [src/termio/Termio.zig:367]: validate configured initial input.
|   |   |-- Exec.threadEnter() [src/termio/Exec.zig:86]
|   |   |   |-- Subprocess.start(): open PTY and launch configured shell/command.
|   |   |   |-- Create exit watcher, write stream, quit pipe and termios timer.
|   |   |   `-- Spawn => [async] Output pipeline; register process-exit and termios callbacks.
|   |   `-- Queue configured input strings/files to PTY.
|   |-- Register mailbox wakeup and stop handlers; xev loop runs until stopCallback().
|   |   |-- [async mailbox event] wakeupCallback() -> drainMailbox(); pop until empty.
|   |   |   |-- Shutdown-drain mode: dispose messages without executing them.
|   |   |   `-- Otherwise dispatch each message [src/termio/Thread.zig:289]:
|   |   |       |-- write_*: Termio.queueWrite() -> Exec.queueWrite() [src/termio/Exec.zig:403].
|   |   |       |   |-- Exited subprocess: discard; otherwise chunk bytes and optionally expand CR to CRLF.
|   |   |       |   `-- xev.Stream.queueWrite() => [async] PTY write; ttyWrite() releases write storage.
|   |   |       |-- resize: handleResize(); keep latest size; arm coalescing timer if not already active.
|   |   |       |-- change_config: Termio.changeConfig(); update terminal defaults and stream settings.
|   |   |       |-- clear_screen / scroll_viewport / jump_to_prompt: mutate Terminal under state lock.
|   |   |       |-- focused / size / color / visibility reports: encode enabled terminal protocol response.
|   |   |       |-- selection_scroll / start_synchronized_output: arm or stop corresponding timer.
|   |   |       `-- After draining any messages: notify renderer => [async] Renderer loop.
|   |   |-- [async coalescing timer] coalesceCallback() -> Termio.resize() [src/termio/Termio.zig:524].
|   |   |   |-- Lock shared state; resize PTY first; Terminal.resize(); optionally send size report.
|   |   |   `-- Unlock; enqueue renderer resize and notify => [async] Renderer loop.
|   |   |-- [async sync-output timeout] syncResetCallback(): resetSynchronizedOutput().
|   |   |-- [async selection timer] selectionScrollCallback(): enqueue selection_scroll_tick -> Dispatch.
|   |   |   `-- Re-arm while scroll_active; stop when selection scrolling is disabled.
|   |   |-- [async termios timer] Exec.termiosTimer(): detect password-input state -> Dispatch.
|   |   `-- [async child exit] Exec.processExitCommon() [src/termio/Exec.zig:274].
|   |       `-- Mark backend exited; enqueue child_exited with status/runtime -> Dispatch.
|   `-- On loop exit: Termio.threadExit() -> Exec.threadExit(); stop subprocess; stop/join output reader.

|-- Consume process output: Exec.ReadThread [src/termio/Exec.zig:1412,1778]
|   |-- POSIX threadMainPosix(): make PTY nonblocking; create bounded rotating-buffer pipeline.
|   |   |-- Spawn => [async] gatherMainPosix(): poll/read until EOF, quit signal or error.
|   |   |   `-- Publish batches; wait for free slots when full; signal completion when gathering ends.
|   |   `-- Reader loop: await batch; process it; release slot; yieldToDemand() for waiting renderer.
|   |       `-- Exit after gather is done and all batches are consumed; join gather worker.
|   |-- Windows threadMainWindows(): serial read/process loop; exit on EOF, quit or read failure.
|   `-- For each delivered batch: Termio.processOutput() [src/termio/Termio.zig:705].
|       |-- Lock renderer_state.mutex; processOutputLocked(); unlock on return.
|       |-- queueRender() => [async] Renderer loop; rate-limit cursor-blink reset messages.
|       |-- Decode batch through terminal_stream [src/terminal/stream.zig:733,1371].
|       |   |-- Inspector enabled: record and parse each byte; otherwise nextSlice() fast path.
|       |   `-- StreamHandler.vt() / vtPrintAscii() [src/termio/stream_handler.zig:188].
|       |       |-- Printable data: Terminal.print / printSlice / printSliceAscii; update cells and cursor.
|       |       |-- Control/escape actions: cursor motion, erasure, attributes, modes and screen switching.
|       |       |-- Graphics / DCS / APC: protocol handling; update terminal image or extension state.
|       |       |-- Terminal query: enqueue response bytes -> I/O loop.
|       |       `-- Title / clipboard / bell / working-directory / UI request: enqueue -> Dispatch.
|       `-- If handler queued I/O messages: notify mailbox => [async] I/O loop.

|-- Update and present frames: renderer.Thread.threadMain_() [src/renderer/Thread.zig:200]
|   |-- Renderer.loopEnter() when supported; threadEnter(); register wakeup / stop / draw_now handlers.
|   |-- Notify initial wakeup; start cursor timer; arm animation timer.
|   `-- xev loop runs until stopCallback(); threadExit() / loopExit() on return.
|       |-- [async wakeup] wakeupCallback() [474]
|       |   |-- drainMailbox(): pop until empty; dispatch renderer control messages [290].
|       |   |   |-- Visibility/focus: update flags, QoS and timers; becoming visible calls -> renderCallback.
|       |   |   |-- Resize/font/config: update screen geometry, shared font grid or renderer settings.
|       |   |   `-- Search/inspector/health: replace highlights, diagnostic flags or presentation state.
|       |   |-- renderCallback() [537]
|       |   |   |-- Display unrealized: releaseGpuResources() under draw lock; return.
|       |   |   |-- Invisible: skip frame update; return.
|       |   |   `-- Otherwise: Renderer.updateFrame() [src/renderer/generic.zig:1371].
|       |   |       |-- lockDemand(); synchronized-output mode skips snapshot update.
|       |   |       |-- Otherwise: optional scroll-to-bottom; advance image animations; RenderState.beginUpdate().
|       |   |       |-- Snapshot terminal cells, preedit, links, scrollbar and overlays; unlock terminal state.
|       |   |       `-- endUpdate(); apply highlights; rebuildOverlay()/rebuildCells(); update frame uniforms.
|       |   |-- During renderCallback, after update: Thread.drawFrame(false) [462].
|       |   |   |-- Invisible or renderer-managed vsync without forced draw: return.
|       |   |   `-- Renderer.drawFrame(false) -> drawFrameLocked() [src/renderer/generic.zig:1716].
|       |   |       |-- Lock draw state; skip unavailable/zero-size display or unchanged frame.
|       |   |       |-- Acquire/rebuild swap chain and frame resources; upload images, cells and font atlases.
|       |   |       |-- Begin graphics frame; draw background, image layers and text; run optional post shaders.
|       |   |       `-- => [GPU completion] frameCompleted(): report changed health -> Dispatch; release frame slot.
|       |   |-- During renderCallback, after draw: armAnimationTimer() if another animation wake is needed.
|       |   `-- After renderCallback returns: Compression.wake() [src/renderer/Thread.zig:773].
|       |       `-- => [idle timer] try-lock state; Terminal.compress(.incremental); retry until complete/disabled.
|       |-- [async draw_now / vsync] drawNowCallback(): call -> Thread.drawFrame(true).
|       |-- [async animation timer] animationTimerCallback() [610]
|       |   |-- Invisible: disarm.
|       |   |-- Image frame due: call -> renderCallback.
|       |   `-- Shader-only animation: call -> Thread.drawFrame(false); re-arm animation timer.
|       `-- [async cursor timer] cursorTimerCallback() [654]: toggle blink; notify wakeup; re-arm until canceled.

|-- Dispatch worker notifications on the app thread: App.tick() [src/App.zig:164,273,532]
|   |-- drainMailbox(): process messages until empty, or stop early on quit.
|   |   `-- surfaceMessage(): verify surface still exists; Surface.handleMessage() [src/Surface.zig:1017].
|   |       |-- change_config: call -> updateConfig; App.updateConfig can also deliver this synchronously.
|   |       |-- Title, colors, pointer, directory, bell, progress, search counts: rt_app.performAction().
|   |       |-- Clipboard request: policy check; call -> clipboard exchange entry points.
|   |       |-- report_title: encode title reply; queueIo() -> I/O loop.
|   |       |-- resize_window: request native resize; runtime later delivers -> sizeCallback.
|   |       |-- redraw: redraw() -> rt_app.performAction(render); runtime presents exported frame.
|   |       |-- renderer_health / scrollbar / present_surface / password_input: update native UI feedback.
|   |       |-- selection_scroll_tick: selectionScrollTick(); update selection/viewport and schedule rendering.
|   |       |-- start_command / stop_command: track elapsed time; report command completion to runtime.
|   |       |-- close: call -> Surface.close.
|   |       `-- child_exited: childExited() [src/Surface.zig:1297].
|   |           |-- Set child_exited; classify exit using runtime threshold and exit status.
|   |           |-- Abnormal exit: show native error or terminal fallback; retain surface.
|   |           `-- Normal exit: show completion notice; wait_after_command retains surface, otherwise -> close.
|   `-- Delivery route: apprt.surface.Mailbox -> App.Mailbox.push() wakes native app loop [src/App.zig:597].

|-- Search terminal history: terminal.search.Thread.threadMain_() [src/terminal/search/Thread.zig:142]
|   |-- Register wakeup/stop handlers; request initial wakeup; start refresh timer.
|   `-- Loop until stopped; drain pending messages and emit quit event on shutdown.
|       |-- No active search: run xev once, waiting for work.
|       `-- Active search: notify pending results; test completion.
|           |-- Complete: wait for next event.
|           `-- Incomplete: TerminalSearch.tick(); if blocked, lock terminal and feedLocked(); run xev no_wait.
|               |-- [mailbox wakeup] drainMailbox(): changeNeedle() or select(); update query/selected match.
|               |-- [refresh timer] refreshCallback(): refresh search against changed terminal/viewport state.
|               `-- notify() -> Surface.searchCallback_() on search thread [src/Surface.zig:1496].
|                   |-- Viewport/selected matches: copy highlights; enqueue => [async] Renderer loop.
|                   |-- Totals/selection index: enqueue => [async] Dispatch.
|                   `-- Quit event: clear renderer highlights and runtime search counters through those queues.

|-- Toggle diagnostic capture: Surface.activateInspector() / deactivateInspector() [src/Surface.zig:934,972]
|   |-- Activate: allocate Inspector; install it in renderer_state under shared mutex.
|   |   `-- Enqueue inspector flags to rendering and I/O; subsequent key/output/frame paths record diagnostics.
|   `-- Deactivate: remove shared pointer under lock; enqueue disabled flags; free Inspector.

`-- Close and destroy the session: Surface.close() / deinit() [src/Surface.zig:829-885]
    |-- close(): needsConfirmQuit(); rt_surface.close(confirm).
    |   |-- Read-only / explicit policy / cursor-at-prompt / exited-child state determines confirmation.
    |   `-- => [runtime lifecycle] after approved destruction, runtime calls deinit(); close does not free directly.
    `-- deinit(): release resources only after their workers stop.
        |-- Stop/join optional search worker.
        |-- Notify renderer stop; join renderer thread.
        |-- Notify I/O stop; join I/O thread, including its subprocess/reader shutdown.
        |-- Renderer.deinit() before renderer.Thread.deinit(); then termio.Thread.deinit().
        |-- Release selection gesture; Termio.deinit(): backend, Terminal, config, mailbox and stream.
        `-- Free inspector, keyboard queues, shared font reference, preedit, state mutex and derived config.
